name: speakup
description: SpeakUp: one server for the API and the built React app

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.postbuild: node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('client/dist/index.html')){console.error('Build failed: client/dist/index.html is missing');process.exit(1)}console.log('Build OK: client/dist/index.html')"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm run test:brand --prefix client && npm run test:tokens --prefix client && npm run test:motion --prefix client && npm run test:ux --prefix client
